summary: Struggle detection feature validated end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest passed for POST /api/coach/cue (struggle, safety, live regression) and POST /api/coach/debrief with a struggles[] payload — all return 200 with well-formed in-persona text. Frontend: Settings screen renders the new 'PHYSIOLOGY & SAFETY' card (testID 'physiology') with Max HR and Age steppers; tapping maxhr-plus twice moved value to 191 bpm, and the value persisted after full navigate-away and back (server-persisted via PUT /api/rider/settings). Live Workout screen loads in Demo mode without any runtime crash and the coach-banner (testID 'coach-banner') renders correctly with Alberto coaching. No React Native or deprecated-package issues detected on the new files (struggle.ts, useStruggleMonitor.ts, workout.tsx, settings.tsx changes).
critical_code_review_comments: coach.py has grown very large (~1000+ lines). Consider splitting into routes/coach_cue.py, routes/coach_debrief.py, routes/coach_chat.py in a future refactor — nothing blocking for this feature.
In settings.tsx line 288, the maxhr-plus formula is subtle: '((maxHr>0 ? maxHr : (age>0 ? 220-age : 190)) - 1) + 1' — behaviour is correct but readability is weak; consider extracting a helper.
